Name: Cozy Christmas Cabin Furniture
Author: rlatmdtntmdtn
Description:
Ivory Christmas Chalet — Nexus Description
[heading]Description · Overview[/heading]
A cozy furniture and exterior collection designed to turn your farm into a warm Christmas chalet, featuring ivory-toned furniture, soft fabrics, natural wood and stone textures, and seasonal decorations.
Along with new furniture, this mod includes [b]four-season building exteriors[/b] and [b]Alternative Textures retextures for chests, large chests, and the standard furnace[/b].
This is an [b]AI-assisted mod[/b]. Generative AI was used to create images and code, which were then edited, assembled, and pixel-adjusted in Aseprite. AI was also used to help write the distribution page and mod description.
The mod is distributed [b]as-is[/b]. I do not plan to provide future updates, bug fixes, compatibility patches, or individual modification requests.
In-game furniture names are currently [b]in Korean[/b].
The thumbnail is an AI-generated promotional illustration inspired by the mod. The seven separate asset-sheet images are preview sheets created by arranging the actual distributed assets. They are [b]not all in-game screenshots[/b].
[line]
[heading]Installation Instructions · Installation[/heading]
Install [b]SMAPI, Content Patcher, SpaceCore, Calcifer, and Alternative Textures[/b] first.
Extract the installation ZIP and place the [b]five included mod folders[/b] into:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]Each folder should contain its own
[code]manifest.json[/code]directly inside it.
The furniture [b][CP] folder[/b] and the companion [b][SMAPI] functionality/fix folder[/b] should be installed together.
Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b].
The [b]Chalet Catalogue[/b] can be purchased from Robin for [b]10,000g[/b]. Once purchased, all furniture included in the catalogue can be obtained from it for free. The catalogue price can be changed using the furniture mod's
[code]CataloguePrice[/code]setting.
For buildings, standard chests, large chests, and the standard furnace, use the [b]Alternative Textures Paint Bucket[/b] to select the appearance you want.
This mod does [b]not[/b] provide or place the buildings, chests, or crafting machines themselves. It only provides alternate appearances for them.
If you are already using an older version of this collection, replace the previous version in the same folders. Do not install multiple versions at the same time.
[line]
[heading]Main Features · Included Content[/heading]
[b]104 furniture items[/b] and [b]1 dedicated catalogue[/b], covering living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, studies, partitions, pillars, rugs, and Christmas decorations.
Includes animated furniture and decorations such as trains, decorative animals, a rocking chair with a blanket, and illuminated decorations.
Includes [b]9 snowy window designs with day/night variations[/b], including a four-tile balcony illusion window with a tea table and steaming cocoa.
There are [b]5 seating items with four directional variants[/b], [b]2 rectangular table types with two directional variants[/b], and [b]5 rugs with two directional variants[/b]. Nearly square tea tables do not rotate.
Includes functional fireplace and lighting behavior, along with decorative lighting supported by the companion functionality mod.
The exterior pack includes [b]68 seasonal exterior variants across 17 building targets[/b]:
House upgrade levels 0–3, three coop stages, three barn stages, two shed stages, silo, mill, well, stable, and fish pond.
The silo is redesigned as a small hay-storage building. The mill retains its rotating blades, and the fish pond retains its normal water-color changes depending on the fish inside.
Includes [b]2 chest retextures[/b] that apply to both standard and large chests. Their appearance remains fixed while opening.
Includes alternate appearances for the [b]standard furnace[/b], covering idle, processing, and completed states while preserving its original crafting functionality and active effects. The [b]Heavy Furnace is not included[/b].
The rocking chair is decorative and cannot be sat on.
The dog and cat furniture pieces are decorative props.
Musical instruments do not play actual music.
Kitchen and bathroom decorations do not add functional appliances.
Decorative doors, stairs, and balconies are visual illusions only and do not create real entrances, additional floors, or outdoor areas.
[line]

Use [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on PC[/b], together with versions of the required mods that are compatible with your game version.

This release has [b]not been fully tested for mobile, multiplayer, or every possible mod combination[/b].
